hero.tagline: Blending Design Theory with 2D/3D Pipelines to Bring Production-Ready Visual Stories to Life.

about.titleHtml: Building AI-driven solutions for real-world problems
paragraphs: I am an Animation and Graphic Design student at the Faculty of Applied Arts at City University in Cairo. By bridging fundamental design theory with modern 2D and 3D pipelines, I bring production-ready visual stories to life. My expertise covers the complete creative lifecycle—from initial pre-production concepts, character design, and storyboarding to 3D modeling, motion graphics, and final post-production compositing..

Leveraging my background in both static graphic design and dynamic motion, I focus on creating assets that are visually compelling, technically clean, and optimized for seamless hand-off in collaborative team environments.

experience.title: Generative AI Intern
experience.desc: Working on generative AI applications within a banking environment, applying LLM-based tools to real business use cases.

experience.title: Machine Learning Intern
experience.desc: Building and training ML models as part of a structured technical training track, covering the full pipeline from data prep to model evaluation.

experience.title: Event Organizer, Volunteer & Alumnus
experience.desc: Organized SecureX 2026, a 2-day cybersecurity awareness event, and contributed to community engagement initiatives for Voltra Wave 2. Part of a team that won 1st place in the program's internal pitch competition, combining event strategy with stakeholder presentation skills.

projects.title: ML Flight Price Perdiction
projects.desc: Built an end-to-end ML system predicting airline ticket prices using a Random Forest Regressor (R²=0.983), covering data preprocessing, EDA, and hyperparameter tuning. Deployed via a FastAPI backend with an interactive HTML/JS dashboard for real-time predictions. Collaborated in a 5-person team.

projects.title: Olist E-Commerce Data Analysis
projects.desc: A comprehensive end-to-end analysis of the Brazilian Olist marketplace dataset covering 100K+ orders. Explored sales trends, customer behavior, delivery performance, and payment patterns through a star-schema data model and interactive dashboards.

projects.title: Medical Insurance Analytics — DEPI Capstone
projects.desc: Built an end-to-end analytics pipeline on a 100K-record dataset: designed a star-schema data warehouse in SQL, processed and modeled the data in Python, and delivered interactive Power BI and Tableau dashboards (heatmaps, scatter plots, box plots, custom filters). Presented findings with a 3-person team to stakeholders.

education.desc: Studying core computer science fundamentals alongside AI and machine learning, with a focus on data-driven problem solving, algorithms, and intelligent systems.

education.degree: Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative (DEPI) — Data Analyst Traineeship
education.desc: National digital upskilling program covering data analysis, Power BI, Python, SQL, and professional analytics workflows. Completed with a medical insurance analytics capstone project built on a 100K-record dataset.

contact.intro: I'm open to freelance projects, collaborations, and full-time data roles. Feel free to reach out — I'd love to hear from you.
